name: Spun Strand
description: Spin a strand of soul force from the hand and cast it round an opponent's soul.

name: Spindle Guard
description: Whirl a spindle of strand before the student so that it winds a soul-strike into itself.

name: Reeling Stride
description: Wind in the strand fixed to a far soul and be carried across by it.

name: Spun Fetter
description: Spin a fetter on a soul that bears down on its force as it turns.

name: Spindle Gauge
description: Run the spindle along a soul and gauge how much holding it can bear.

name: Reeling Lash
description: Lash a strand at an opponent's soul and reel it back with a bite of force.

name: Spun Shackle
description: Spin a shackle round the soul in many turns until it cannot move or gather force.

name: Skein Crush
description: Draw the skein inward all at once so that the held soul is crushed down hard.

name: Spun Immurement
description: Spin a wall of cord about a soul so that no technique can leave it until the wall is cut.

name: Radiant Skein
description: Spin the school's radiant skein from the whole of the student's soul and wind it round a soul so that it is held and pressed to the ground.

name: Stilling Strand
description: Lay a stilling strand on an opponent's soul so that it moves less with each breath.

name: Hush Wrap
description: Wrap a hush about the student that deadens a soul-strike.

name: Still Hitch
description: Hitch to a stilled soul and cross to it without a ripple in the field.

name: Stilled Fetter
description: Close a fetter that stills every limb of the soul's intent but one.

name: Hush Gauge
description: Gauge how deeply a soul has been stilled and how long it will stay so.

name: Hush Lash
description: Lash a still strand across a soul so that it lands with no warning stir.

name: Hushed Manacle
description: Close a hushed manacle that holds the soul silent and unable to cast.

name: Silencing Weight
description: Lay a silencing weight on the soul so that its force falls to a murmur.

name: Stilled Seal
description: Set a seal that stills the whole of a soul's technique until the seal is lifted.

name: Unstirring Hush
description: Bring the school's perfect stillness down on a soul so that it neither stirs nor casts nor speaks for as long as the hush holds.

name: Anchored Strand
description: Anchor a strand to the Core and cast it on a soul so that the hold has the Core's weight behind it.

name: Rooted Wrap
description: Root a wrap in the Core so that a soul-strike finds it immovable.

name: Steady Hitch
description: Hitch to a far soul with the Core's steadiness and cross without a sway.

name: Coreward Hold
description: Hold a soul with the Core's weight so that it cannot be shaken loose by pulling.

name: Rooted Gauge
description: Take a gauge of the held soul through the root of the hold.

name: Unyielding Cinch
description: Cinch the hold until the soul's force sinks and stays down.

name: Staying Breath
description: Hold the breath of the hold still and let a soul-bolt slide off its tight surface.

name: Unbreakable Shackle
description: Close a shackle on the soul that no strain can part.

name: Unyielding Crush
description: Crush the hold inward with the Core's full weight so that the soul is flattened.

name: Immutable Binding
description: Fix a binding that does not change and seals the soul's technique for as long as the Core stands.

name: Unbreakable Hold
description: Close the school's unbreakable hold on a soul so that it can neither move nor rise against the hold.

name: Squall Strand
description: Whip a squall strand round an opponent's soul and draw it snug.

name: Gale Wrap
description: Spin a wrap of gale force before the student so that a soul-bolt is flung wide.

name: Storm Hitch
description: Hitch to a far soul on a rush of storm force and cross in a breath.

name: Storm Gyve
description: Close a gyve of storm force on a soul that presses its strength down.

name: Squall Sounding
description: Read the pressure of the soul-field through the squall to find which soul is about to move.

name: Thundering Lash
description: Lash a strand through the soul with a crack like thunder.

name: Gale Snare
description: Lay a snare of gale force in the soul-field that springs on the first soul to cross it.

name: Snare Burst
description: Burst the snare outward so that every soul near it is thrown and bound.

name: Squall Immurement
description: Close a squall about a soul so that its techniques cannot cross the storm.

name: Stormfast Snare
description: Raise the school's great snare across the field and spring it so that every soul in it is held fast and struck.

name: Spoken Strand
description: Speak a word and let it close as a strand on an opponent's soul.

name: Troth Wrap
description: Wrap an ally in the student's troth so that a soul-strike falls on the troth instead.

name: Pledged Hitch
description: Hitch to the pledge of an ally and cross to their side in one step.

name: Word Gyve
description: Close a gyve with a spoken word on the technique an opponent is about to loose.

name: Troth Gauge
description: Gauge how faithfully a soul keeps the troth it has given.

name: Spoken Lash
description: Lash a spoken word through the soul of one who lied so that the lie stings.

name: Spoken Shackle
description: Hold a soul in a shackle made of a spoken word so that it cannot move while the word stands.

name: Word Crush
description: Speak the breach aloud so that the weight of the word presses the soul down.

name: Spoken Seal
description: Speak the seal on a soul so that its techniques stay shut while the word is unbroken.

name: Binding Word
description: Speak the school's binding word over a soul that broke faith so that it is held and every technique it knows is sealed.

name: Open Strand
description: Cast an open strand across the domain that lies on any soul it touches.

name: Loose Wrap
description: Let a loose wrap hang about the student where it slips a soul-bolt wide.

name: Casting Hitch
description: Cast a hitch to any point of the domain and cross to it in one step.

name: Open Meshing
description: Mesh the open strands over a soul so that its movement is checked all round.

name: Net Gauge
description: Gauge every soul touched by the net and tell which is straining.

name: Spreading Snare
description: Spread a snare across a forming technique and tangle it before it is loosed.

name: Net Lash
description: Lash a net's weighted edge across a soul within the domain.

name: Open Net
description: Spread an open net over the domain and draw it in on every soul inside.

name: Net Crush
description: Close the net hard so that every soul in it is crushed together.

name: Netted Seal
description: Seal the techniques of every soul in the net until the net is drawn off.

name: Boundless Net
description: Spread the school's boundless net across the whole domain so that no soul within it escapes the hold.
